purpose: Teach: 西川/横山/藤本/新田/飯田/西尾/木下/秋山

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の西川部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome Nishikawa, our newly appointed department head.
lines.style: Direct command. Clipped, authoritative opening. Measured pace. No warmth, no pause for questions. The voice of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の横山課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the travel schedule for Yokoyama, our sales manager.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Efficient, no-nonsense. Slight nod in the voice. Moves forward immediately to next task without elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、取引先の藤本社長との会合を設定しろ
lines.en: Set up a meeting with Fujimoto, our client's president.
lines.style: Directive tone. Firm opening on the verb. Spare delivery. Expects compliance without explanation. Professional distance maintained throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新田主任の研修プログラムを企画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll design a training program for Nitta, our newly appointed supervisor.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Professional, matter-of-fact. Takes on the task without fanfare. Steady, reliable delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本部長の飯田様の引退式を準備しろ
lines.en: Prepare the retirement ceremony for Iida, our headquarters director.
lines.style: Steady directive. Weight behind the request—this is significant but delivered without sentiment. Clipped pacing. Expects careful handling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の西尾様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll implement the strategy Nishio from PR has prepared.
lines.style: Affirming, efficient. Brief and clean. No inflection needed—just execution. The tone of someone who knows exactly what needs to happen next.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事担当の木下様を主任に昇格させろ
lines.en: Promote Kinoshita from human resources to supervisor.
lines.style: Clear order. Authoritative but not harsh. Confident in the decision. Slight emphasis on the promotion itself—this is definitive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。技術主任の秋山様にプロジェクトを任せます
lines.en: Understood. I'll assign the project to Akiyama, our technical supervisor.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm and assured. The delivery of someone closing out a list of tasks. Settles the matter with quiet finality.
